title: Make guidance part of the app
summary: Rebuilds onboarding, feature education, What’s New and version history into progressive, contextual experiences that teach Night Roster only when the user needs help.
changes: First use is now a focused three-step setup: confirm your roster identity, learn where your own night appears, and understand that the normal six-nurse plan is automatic unless something genuinely changes.

Changes, Breaks and Team Chat now explain themselves the first time they are opened, while Account has a proper App Guide with reusable topic shortcuts and one education-state system that still respects earlier completed guidance.

What’s New is now benefit-led and easier to scan, with feature actions, a compact expandable month-grouped version history, smarter quiet/normal/important release visibility, and update read-state recorded only after the update experience is actually viewed.
